vocab.sentence: Giving red envelopes is an important custom during the Lunar New Year.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 農曆新年期間送紅包是一項重要傳統。

vocab.sentence: At the Christmas party, students happily exchanged gifts and had a good time.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 在聖誕派對上，學生們開心地交換禮物，度過了愉快的時光。

vocab.sentence: Teresa waved her hand in greeting when her brother got out of the train station.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Teresa 的哥哥走出火車站時，她揮手向他打招呼。

vocab.sentence: Many students attended the school ceremony yesterday.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 昨天有許多學生參加學校典禮。

vocab.sentence: The principal delivered an inspiring speech at the graduation ceremony.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 校長在畢業典禮上發表了一場激勵人心的演講。

vocab.sentence: The accident was caused by human error.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這起事故是人為錯誤造成的。

vocab.sentence: The mailman delivers letters to the remote village in the mountains once a week.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 郵差每週一次將信件送到山中的偏遠村落。

vocab.sentence: More than one million people visit the city every year.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 每年有超過一百萬人造訪這座城市。

vocab.sentence: Drivers must follow the speed limits on this road.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 駕駛人必須遵守這條道路的速限。

phrases.chinese: 供你參考；告訴你（縮寫 FYI）
phrases.sentence: For your information, all our products come with a one-year warranty.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 告訴你，我們所有產品都附有一年保固。
